lines.en: Well, she's been saying she needs a lamp by her bed,
so I made her one entirely out of gummy bears!
- So you think she'll like it? - She's gonna love it.
Do you guys know how the fire started?
This bedside table lamp started the fire.
But I don't have a table lamp.
Look, Spencer wanted to make you a special present for your birthday.
So he made you a gummy bear lamp.
